name: Sister of Silence
oracle_text:
Flash
Psychic Abomination — When this creature enters, counter target instant spell, sorcery spell, activated ability, or triggered ability.
blocked_sentences: Psychic Abomination — When this creature enters, counter target instant spell, sorcery spell, activated ability, or triggered ability.

needs.what: a `spell_or_ability` target whose SPELL half can be narrowed by printed characteristics (here `any_types: ["Instant", "Sorcery"]`) while its ability half still admits every activated or triggered ability on the stack -- e.g. a `spell_selector` sub-filter read by `targeting._spell_matches` for spells only, with the existing `controller`/`that_targets` clauses still shared by both halves
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `loader.targets._compile_target` refuses any `spell_or_ability` selector key other than `controller` and `that_targets`, precisely because a type clause would narrow only the spell half; Disallow's plain `spell_or_ability` would also counter creature, artifact, enchantment and planeswalker spells, which this card cannot. A `spell` target (any_types Instant/Sorcery) drops the abilities, `ability_on_stack` drops the spells, and a `choose_mode` splitting the one target into two modes restructures the printed single target into an unprinted modal choice
